description: This Java source file defines the 'InvalidOptionException' class, which is a custom exception used within the 'thingsearch' process of the Eclipse Ditto project. It is thrown when a search option provided in a request is invalid. The class includes builder semantics and methods to create instances from messages or JSON objects.
